record.title: Cuphead
record.description:
Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era: traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

Play as Cuphead or Mugman (in single player or local co-op) as you traverse strange worlds, acquire new weapons, learn powerful super moves, and discover hidden secrets while you try to pay your debt back to the devil!

record.title: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition [Switch 2]
record.description:
Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition is an open-world action-adventure RPG set in Night City, a sprawling futuristic megalopolis driven by power, glamour and body modification. You play as V, a customizable cyber-enhanced mercenary whose choices, relationships, skills and combat style shape a deeply branching journey through the dark future.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Ultimate Edition includes the full Cyberpunk 2077 base game and the Phantom Liberty spy-thriller expansion set in Dogtown. It also benefits from the major systems, gameplay and quality-of-life improvements released for the modern version of the game.

This edition was specifically optimized for Nintendo Switch 2 and supports Joy-Con 2 motion controls, adjustable gyroscope aiming, Joy-Con 2 mouse controls and touch-screen interaction for maps, menus, inventory and hacking. Cross-progression lets supported saves continue between platforms. Two graphics modes are available: Quality mode targets 1080p at 30 FPS, while Performance mode targets up to 40 FPS at 1080p in TV mode and 720p in handheld mode. Handheld play also uses VRR for smoother presentation.

record.worldSummary: Night City is a vast dystopian metropolis on the California coast where corporations, gangs, mercenaries and fixers compete for influence. Its districts range from neon-packed commercial centers and corporate towers to industrial zones, gang-controlled neighborhoods and the surrounding Badlands. Phantom Liberty expands the playable world with Dogtown, a dangerous walled-off district ruled by a militarized faction. The setting combines high technology, extreme inequality, cybernetic body modification and a culture obsessed with reputation and survival.

faq.q: Does Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition on Nintendo Switch 2 include Phantom Liberty?
faq.a: Yes. The Nintendo Switch 2 Ultimate Edition includes both the full Cyberpunk 2077 base game and the Phantom Liberty expansion.

faq.q: Does the physical Nintendo Switch 2 version require a full-game download?
faq.a: No. The physical release uses a 64 GB game card containing the full game. Updates and optional voiceover language packs can still require downloads.

faq.q: Does the Nintendo Switch 2 version support Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. Arabic text is supported in the Global version. Arabic is text-only; an Arabic voiceover is not listed by CD PROJEKT RED.

record.verdictSummary: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition is one of the most ambitious third-party releases on Nintendo Switch 2. It delivers the complete modern Cyberpunk 2077 experience, including Phantom Liberty, in a portable format while adding thoughtful platform-specific controls. Visual and frame-rate compromises remain compared with more powerful consoles and high-end PCs, but the Switch 2 release is a strong technical conversion and a compelling way to experience Night City on the go.
verdictPros: Complete package with the base game and Phantom Liberty expansion
Excellent portable flexibility with gyro, motion, touch and mouse control options
Deep RPG systems, memorable characters, strong world-building and extensive replay value
verdictCons: Lower visual fidelity than high-end PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series versions
Performance can dip below targets in demanding scenes, especially in Phantom Liberty
Large storage footprint and optional voiceover packs require additional downloads

reviews.quote: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition offers tens, if not hundreds, of hours of engrossing open world action.

record.title: Dead by Daylight
record.description:
Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming's best asymmetrical multiplayer.

SURVIVE TOGETHER… OR NOT - Survivors can either cooperate with the others or be selfish. Your chance of survival will vary depending on whether you work together as a team or if you go at it alone. Will you be able to outwit the Killer and escape their Killing Ground?

A FEAST FOR KILLERS - Dead by Daylight draws from all corners of the horror world. As a Killer, you can play as anything from a powerful slasher to terrifying paranormal entities. Familiarize yourself with your killing grounds and master each Killer’s unique power to be able to hunt, catch and sacrifice your victims. This deadly game of cat and mouse also lets you meet some of the most iconic Killers and Survivors from horror franchises.

DEEPER AND DEEPER - Each Killer and Survivor has their own deep progression system and plenty of unlockables that can be customized to fit your own personal strategy. Experience, skills and understanding of the environment are key to being able to hunt or outwit the Killer.

REAL PEOPLE, REAL FEAR - The unique levels and real human reactions to pure horror make each game session an unexpected scenario. You will never be able to tell how it’s going to turn out. Ambience, music, and chilling environments combine into a terrifying experience. With enough time, you might even discover what’s hiding in The Fog.

record.title: DELTARUNE
record.description:
A parallel story to UNDERTALE where Kris, Susie and Ralsei explore mysterious Dark Worlds, solve puzzles, and fight or spare enemies in turn-based battles with real-time bullet-dodging.

Kris and Susie are pulled from everyday life into hidden Dark Worlds with their own rulers and conflicts. Ralsei becomes a key ally, explaining prophecies and helping the party navigate these unstable realms. Each chapter introduces a distinct setting, emotional tone and battle gimmick while deepening the larger mystery. The story balances comedy, melancholy, suspense and meta-narrative ideas that connect it to UNDERTALE while remaining its own work.

faq.q: Do choices matter?
faq.a: Choices affect encounters, dialogue flavor and how the player approaches enemies.

faq.q: Who will enjoy it most?
faq.a: Players who value story, music, humor and unusual RPG structure.
